# Fixture maintenance

Edit source/api.json when changing fixture examples. Run make refresh-fixtures from the project root, inspect the fixtures/api.json diff, then run make check. Never hand-edit derived fixtures. If source/api.json is missing or invalid, stop and report the error; do not invent source data. All commands are local and require no credentials.

files.scripts/fixtures.py:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source = json.loads(Path("source/api.json").read_text())
expected = json.dumps(source, indent=2) + "\n"
output = Path("fixtures/api.json")
if sys.argv[1:] == ["refresh"]:
    output.write_text(expected)
elif sys.argv[1:] == ["check"]:
    if output.read_text() != expected:
        sys.exit("derived fixture differs from source; run make refresh-fixtures")
    print("fixture source and formatting passed")
else:
    sys.exit("usage: fixtures.py refresh|check")
